candidates.failure_scenario: handler_http.go:555 builds the expression with fmt.Sprintf("ResolveName(%q)", username), so the adapter takes an already-concatenated Gno expression and the interface doc names that the caller's problem. Nothing reachable today is unsafe — GetUserView:608 rejects anything outside gno.Re_name before userExists runs, and the address branch never reaches it — but the contract is the one a second caller inherits: the next Eval user gets a raw-string API and a doc telling it to be careful. The deeper form is for the adapter to quote, `Eval(ctx, pkgPath, fn string, args ...any)` formatting each argument with %q, so an unquoted expression cannot be built at a call site at all.
